text:
ada: Hey team — quick design sprint follow-up. I pushed a small mock for the encryption badge + retention tooltip in the console. Want to get copy + a11y eyes on it.

sam: saw the mock, link?

ada: https://figma.redwood/enc-badge-v2 (mock 3) — top-right of dataset card. Badge reads: 'Encrypted' with a shield icon. Tooltip on hover: 'Data encrypted with customer-managed keys (KMS) when enabled)'.

mira: overall looks good. two security notes: 1) wording should clarify whether keys are customer-managed vs platform-managed. 2) We should show which KMS key ID is used in the audit/log view, not in the badge tooltip (privacy).

leo: Copy proposal for tooltip: 
```
Encrypted — protected at rest.
Encryption managed by: Redwood (default) or Customer KMS.
Click to view audit details.
```

rachel: a11y nit: tooltip needs role=tooltip and keyboard focus target. Badge should be a button (not just a span) with aria-pressed false. Also icon needs aria-hidden=true if there's visible text.

sam: implementation note: current badge is inline SVG + span. I can make it a <button class=\"enc-badge\"> with tabindex=0 and attach aria-describedby to the tooltip. Will need guidance on exact text length — long tooltips are annoying on mobile.

ada: good call. For mobile we should open a small full-screen sheet for details instead of hover tooltip — existing pattern on dataset detail page.

mira: also: retention dropdown on same card — UX confusion when retention says '90' but no unit. Add suffix 'days' in compact list view. And the retention setting should show a lock icon when data retention is governed by policy (e.g., org-level override).

leo: suggested retention copy for compact: 'Retention: 90 days' and in expanded view: 'Data retained for 90 days. Learn more.' Link goes to docs. For policy lock: 'Retention: 90 days (set by org policy)'.

rachel: color contrast: current badge green (#18A56B) fails AA against white text at small sizes. Either darken to #0F8C55 or switch to bold label + dark text. Also ensure focus outline is visible when keyboarding.

sam: noted. Changing to #0F8C55 and using 600 weight for text should pass. Will run contrast check after patch.

ada: audit log copy — I posted the sample entries. Currently reads: 'ENCRYPTION: key=abc123 used'. That feels raw. Mira, what should we show instead?

mira: show action-style entries: 'Encryption: Customer KMS key redwood-prod-01 applied to dataset XYZ by service-account@redwood (2025-11-12T14:22Z)'. Avoid leaking full key material in UI; show human-readable alias or key ID only.

leo: proposed audit-line copy: 'Encryption applied — key: redwood-prod-01 (KMS), actor: redwood-service, time: Nov 12, 2025 14:22 UTC'. Keeps it readable.

ada: love it. Also add a small 'View details' link that opens a modal with full audit item (time, actor, key ID, request id).

rachel: ensure the audit modal obeys reduced-motion, has focus-trap, and that the 'View details' link is announced (aria-haspopup=dialog). Also ensure screen reader sees the difference between 'managed by Redwood' vs 'customer-managed' — that phrasing matters semantically.

leo: small copy tweak for badge aria-label: if customer-managed -> 'Encrypted with customer-managed key'; else -> 'Encrypted (Redwood-managed keys)'. That gives explicit SR context.

sam: will implement aria-label logic. Question: should clicking badge take you to the dataset security page or open the modal? Ada?

ada: prefer modal for quick peek, link to security page for full config. Keep primary click = modal, secondary action in modal to go to security page.

deploy-bot: deploy-preview created for branch `enc-badge-a11y` — https://staging.redwood/preview/enc-badge-a11y — build #4123.

sam: testing now. Found a small bug — tooltip overflows the card on small widths. Will anchor to viewport with flip logic.

ada: ok, final checklist before merging: 
- copy: leo to finalize two lines (tooltip short + modal header).
- security: mira to confirm audit fields to display.
- a11y: rachel to run keyboard/JAWS check on preview.
- frontend: sam to update color + aria props and fix overflow.

leo: final suggestions: tooltip short: 'Encrypted — key management: Redwood or Customer KMS.'
modal header: 'Encryption details — dataset XYZ'.

mira: approved for security surface.

rachel: I did quick keyboard test on preview — focus order good, but modal close button label reads 'Close' only; prefer 'Close encryption details' for clarity. Small change.

sam: will push small PR with label change and contrast fix.

ada: thanks all. Merging after PR passes and rachel signs off on accessibility. :sparkles: 

leo: :thumbsup:

mira: :eyes:
